articles.headline: SAFA confirms death of Bafana midfielder Jayden Adams' grandmother
articles.description: SAFA confirmed Mamelodi Sundowns and Bafana midfielder Jayden Adams played through grief at the FIFA World Cup a day after his grandmother's death.

articles.headline: 'I could write you a book about Sadio Mane' - Pape Thiaw lauds Senegal legend as Last 32 berth secured
articles.description: Senegal head coach Pape Thiaw has heaped praise on Sadio Mane after the Teranga Lions breathed life into their World Cup campaign with a 5-0 demolition of Iraq on Friday, ultimately securing their progress to the knockou

articles.headline: World Cup Daily LIVE: Cristiano Ronaldo's new golden boots, Argentina rest Messi as final groups decided
articles.description: It's the final day of World Cup action from the group stages, as Portugal's Cristiano Ronaldo and Argentina's Lionel Messi (maybe) could play on the same day.

articles.headline: Antoine Semenyo urges Ghana to be 'more aggressive' with referees after England VAR snub
articles.description: Antoine Semenyo has urged his Ghana teammates to put more pressure on officials after the Black Stars didn't get a VAR check for at least one incident that went against them in their draw with England on Tuesday.

articles.headline: Ghana have nothing to lose vs. Croatia, but higher honours beckon
articles.description: Ghana go into their final group game against Croatia on Saturday knowing that results elsewhere have already secured them their place in the World Cup knockout stages for the first time since 2010.

articles.headline: Bafana's World Cup clash with Canada can change South Africa's football trajectory
articles.description: When Hugo Broos' Bafana Bafana face Canada in the FIFA World Cup round of 32 at Los Angeles Stadium, a win could make a major difference to South Africa's football ecosystem.
